App_Title: Max Potion — Pokémon Save File Editor
Main_Welcome: Open a save file to get started
Release_DisabledTip: The party needs at least one Pokémon
Release_Body: It is removed from the save and can't be recovered from the app once exported. You can undo it before exporting.
Release_ItemWarning: Holding: {0}. The item is lost too.
Release_UndoNoRoom: Can't undo: the party or box is already full.
Release_UndoSlotTaken: Can't undo: that slot is now occupied.
Release_Blocked_Body: It's the only Pokémon in the party and the game needs at least one. Move another Pokémon to the party and try again.
IvSolver_Banner_Text: With these IVs the Pokémon is no longer legal in this encounter.
IvSolver_Searching_Hint: You can cancel at any time: the Pokémon doesn't change until you apply a result.
IvSolver_Found_Verified: Checked with the legality analyzer: no errors
IvSolver_None_Title: That combination doesn't exist in this encounter
IvSolver_None_Exhaustive_Closest: Every possible seed was checked ({1}) and none produces those IVs. The closest legal combination differs by {0} IV point(s):
IvSolver_None_NotExhaustive_Closest: No combination with those IVs was found ({1}). The closest legal combination differs by {0} IV point(s):
IvSolver_None_NoCandidate: No legal combination was found for this Pokémon.
AutoFix_Done_Text: The diagnostics will refresh in a moment. If an error remains, check its details.
AutoFix_Failed_Text: Some fixes search at random and sometimes find nothing: you can try again. If the suggested value is already the current one, this fix doesn't resolve this error.
Dialog_About_Description: A Pokémon save file editor, native to Linux and also available on other platforms.
Error_InvalidSave: The file is not a valid Pokémon save
SaveError_InvalidSave_Message: That file isn't a valid Pokémon save. Try a different file.
SaveError_Corrupted_Message: This file is damaged and couldn't be fully read. Try a backup copy.
SaveError_NotFound_Message: That file isn't where you left it. It may have been moved or deleted.
SaveError_PermissionDenied_Message: You don't have permission to read this file. Check the folder's permissions.
Recreate_Row_Available: Can be recreated with a valid encounter
Recreate_Row_Text: There are {0} options. Species, level, moves, nickname, held item, original trainer and {1} are kept; the capture data changes.
Recreate_NoFix_Text: No {0} encounter matches this Pokémon's moves, so there is no valid origin to recreate it with. These moves are not legal:
Recreate_NoFix_Hint: Change them to legal moves and check the diagnostic again: if a compatible encounter shows up afterwards, this fix is offered automatically.
Recreate_Modal_Subtitle: Choose the origin you want to give the Pokémon
Recreate_Gen4_Note: In Gen4 the Nature and gender come from the PID, and the PID depends on the IVs, so they may change. Each option shows the exact result. IVs, ability and shininess are kept.
Recreate_PickHint: Choose an option to be able to apply it.
Recreate_Done: Origin recreated: the encounter error is gone.
Recreate_Catch_Subtitle: The current catch rate ({0}) is not valid for this Pokémon.
Recreate_Catch_Why: Because of its moves, this Pokémon went through Gen2, so the catch rate must be a Gen2 item (or 0, no item). 0 is proposed because it leaves the Pokémon legal without inventing an item.
Recreate_Level_Subtitle: {0} at level {1} is too low to exist with a valid encounter: it is raised to level {2}.
Recreate_Level_Warning: This changes visible data: level and experience. It is the minimum level with which a valid encounter exists.
Recreate_Level_Row: {0}'s level is too low for any encounter. It can be raised to the minimum valid level ({1}).
Recreate_KeepNature_Hint: In Gen3/4 the Nature comes from the PID. To keep it, the closest possible IVs that have a valid PID are searched; the table shows which IVs change.
Recreate_KeepNature_Busy: Searching combinations… this can take a few seconds.
Recreate_KeepNature_None: No option keeps the Nature with valid IVs. Untick the box to see the others.
Recreate_Iv_Title: Choose IVs with a valid PID
Recreate_Iv_Subtitle: No valid PID matches the current IVs. These combinations, as close as possible, do have one.
Recreate_Iv_Why: Every Gen3/4 wild or static Pokémon comes from a seed that sets PID and IVs together, and some IV combinations that seed never produces. Shininess, ability and gender are kept; the listed IVs change.
Recreate_Iv_NoneFound: No nearby IV combination with a valid PID was found for this encounter. The Pokémon may not come from a Method 1 PID encounter (egg, gift, event…): check the technical detail in the Legal tab.
Lang_DataFallbackEnglish_Long: PKHeX has no data for the interface language, so species, moves, items and other game names are shown in English.
Lang_LongDescNote: Long descriptions of moves, abilities and items are always shown in English.
Toolbar_Note_Tip: Note this session's changes (does not export the save file)
Toolbar_Discard_Tip: Discard edits and go back to the original save
Toolbar_Close_Tip: Close the save and return to the start screen
Editor_Empty_Body: Pick one from the box or the party to view and edit its identity, status and origin.
Editor_Preview_Sub: This is what you'll see when you select one
Tab_IvsEvs_Desc: Base stats, IVs, EVs and nature.
Tab_Learnsets_Desc: Which moves it can learn and how.
Tab_Sets_Desc: Recommended sets from Smogon and Showdown.
Tab_Special_Desc: Special mechanics by game: Mega, Z-Moves, Dynamax, Tera and Alpha.
Tab_Ribbons_Desc: The Pokémon's ribbons and marks (depending on the game).
Dialog_CloseUnsaved_Body: There are changes from this session you haven't exported yet — they will be lost if you close now.
Dialog_Discard_Body: The save goes back to how it was when loaded — all changes from this session that you haven't exported are lost.
Dialog_OpenOther_Body: There are changes from this session in the current save that you haven't exported yet — they will be lost if you open another file.
Status_EditsDiscarded: Edits discarded — the save went back to its original state.
Stats_Base_Tip: Species stat at this level, without IVs, EVs or nature
Moves_PpUps_Tip: PP Ups (0–3). No PP Ups: Sketch / Revival Blessing
Special_Unequip_Tip: Leave the Pokémon without a held item
Special_AlphaWarn: Changing "Is Alpha" may make the Pokémon illegal if it does not match its original encounter
Legal_AllClear: No legality problems or notes were found for this Pokémon.
Hint_Item_Both: Mega Stones and Z-Crystals are chosen from the Special tab.
Hint_Item_Mega: Mega Stones are chosen from the Special tab.
Hint_Item_Z: Z-Crystals are chosen from the Special tab.
Special_Warn_ZReplacesMega: A Z-Crystal is equipped ({0}): equipping a Mega Stone replaces it.
Special_Warn_MegaReplacesZ: A Mega Stone is equipped ({0}): equipping a Z-Crystal replaces it.
Stats_HpDvNote: In this generation the HP DV is derived from Atk/Def/Spe/Special — it is not an independent value.
Stats_EvTotal_NoCap: {0} (no combined cap — each stat caps at 65535)
Special_GmaxNote: This species has no Gigantamax form: enabling it would make it illegal.
Special_Mega_NoStone: ✗ No Mega Stone equipped for this species
Special_Mega_None: This species has no Mega Evolution.
Tera_Note_Egg: Eggs cannot have a Tera Type override.
Tera_Note_Ogerpon: Ogerpon's Tera Type depends on its mask and cannot be changed here.
Tera_Note_Terapagos: Terapagos does not support a Tera Type override.
Tera_Note_Default: Equivalent to spending Tera Shards in the game. The Legal tab validates the result.
Special_Z_OtherSpecies_Advisory: {0} is exclusive to another species: it has no effect on this Pokémon.
Special_Z_NotKnown_Note: The exclusive Z-Move can only be used if the Pokémon knows that move
Special_Z_NotKnown_Advisory: {0} is equipped, but the Pokémon doesn't know {1}: it won't be able to use {2}.
Special_Z_NoDamaging: ✗ Equipped, but no damaging move is compatible
Special_Z_StatusNote: {0} is {1}-type but it is a status move — it has no Z-Move of its own
Special_Z_NoMatch_Advisory: {0} is equipped, but none of the Pokémon's damaging moves is {1}-type: it won't be able to use a Z-Move.
Special_Mega_WrongSpecies: {0} is equipped, but it does not match this species: it has no effect.
Special_TechPrefix: Max Potion notice (not a PKHeX rule; the save is legal as it is):
Info_Nickname_Tip: Has a nickname? (pkm.IsNicknamed — it ticks itself when you type, but you can untick it by hand)
Bag_Pouches_Hint: The available categories depend on the generation of the loaded save.
Bag_Max_Tip: Raise to the maximum allowed by this game
Pokedex_NoEvolutionData: No evolution chain data for this species.
Pokedex_NoOriginData: No origin data available for the loaded game.
Pokedex_TapOutside: Tap outside the card to go back
Picker_Keys_Hint: ← → move · Shift+← → jump (10% of the filtered set) · Home/End extremes · Enter creates
Legality_Friendly_Nickname: The nickname is not valid for this Pokémon (language or format not allowed for its origin).
Legality_Friendly_Level: The level is not valid for this Pokémon's origin.
Legality_Friendly_Ability: The ability does not belong to this species or form.
Legality_Friendly_Nature: The nature is not compatible with this Pokémon's origin.
Legality_Friendly_IvsEvs: The IVs, EVs or other effort values are outside the allowed range.
Legality_Friendly_Moves: One or more moves are not valid for the current level or species.
Legality_Friendly_Location: The origin data (capture location) is not consistent.
Legality_Friendly_Encounter: How this Pokémon was obtained (wild encounter, egg, event, etc.) does not match the rest of its data.
Legality_Friendly_Evolution: This Pokémon could not have evolved under the conditions given by its other data.
Legality_Friendly_Egg: The egg data (location or date) is not valid.
Legality_Friendly_OriginGame: The origin game is not compatible with the rest of this Pokémon's data.
Legality_Friendly_Shiny: The shiny state is not possible for this Pokémon's origin.
Legality_Friendly_Gender: The gender is not valid for this species or does not match other data of the Pokémon.
Legality_Friendly_Form: The form is not valid for this species or its origin.
Legality_Friendly_Language: The configured language is not valid for this Pokémon's origin.
Legality_Friendly_Fateful: The “special encounter” (Fateful Encounter) flag does not match this Pokémon's origin.
Legality_Friendly_Ball: The Poké Ball is not valid for how this Pokémon was caught.
Legality_Friendly_HeldItem: The held item is not valid for this species or its origin.
Legality_Friendly_Ribbons: A ribbon or mark does not match this Pokémon's origin.
Legality_Friendly_Marks: The Pokémon's marks are not valid.
Legality_Friendly_Memories: The memory data with the trainer is not valid.
Legality_Friendly_Training: The stat training (e.g. Hyper Training) is not valid for this Pokémon's level.
Legality_Friendly_Trainer: The trainer data (name, ID, or who handled it) is not consistent.
Legality_Friendly_Internal: An internal value (PID, seed or padding data) does not match the rest of the Pokémon's information — this usually happens with Pokémon edited with another tool or from saves of dubious origin.
Legality_Friendly_Other: There is an additional invalid value for this Pokémon.
Legality_Friendly_Fallback: This Pokémon has a value that is not valid for its origin or species.
Legality_Fix_MemoryHandler: Review the memory data with the Handler
Legality_Fix_MemoryOT: Review the memory data with the OT
Legality_Cur_PkrsStrain: strain not available in this game
Legality_Fix_PkrsStrain: disable Pokérus or use a strain obtainable here
Legality_Fix_NickLanguage: does not match the default name in any valid language — check the “has nickname?” checkbox next to the field
Legality_Fix_WordFilter: contains disallowed text/format — review and retype
Legality_Fix_AbilityManual: review manually — could not be calculated
Legality_Fix_PidMethod1: regenerate with the game's real algorithm (Method 1) — may change Nature/Ability/Gender as a side effect, see button
Legality_Fix_PidEgg: generate a random PID with no RNG pattern, as eggs require — keeps Nature, Gender, Ability and Shiny
Legality_Fix_PidSeed: find a game seed that legally produces these IVs
Legality_Fix_PidSeedLocked: in this encounter the IVs come from a game seed: changing them breaks that relation and there is no automatic fix — going back to the original IVs makes it legal
Legality_Fix_CatchRate: recalculate automatically (the species' rate for this game)
Legality_Fix_NoEncounter: does not match any valid encounter for this Pokémon — review
Legality_Move_Duplicate: duplicated — cannot appear twice in the moveset
Legality_Move_EmptyInvalid: should have a move here, it is empty
Legality_Move_Unobtainable: cannot be learned by this species in this game at this level by any method
Legality_Move_Invalid: is not valid for this species/encounter

About_Description: A Pokémon save file editor, native to Linux and also available on other platforms.
About_Legal: Pokémon and its names are trademarks of Nintendo, Creatures and Game Freak. This is a fan project with no affiliation. Back up your save before editing it.
Credits_Translation_Note: Translated by Claude, an AI assistant made by Anthropic, without review by native speakers. Corrections are welcome.
Credits_Trademarks: Pokémon © Nintendo, Creatures Inc., GAME FREAK inc. Sprites and game data belong to their respective owners.
Sys_Intro: Technical information about this installation. It contains no trainer name, ID or save contents.
Report_Intro: This opens a pre-filled form on GitHub in your browser. Max Potion sends nothing by itself: you review and submit it there.
Report_NotIncluded: Never included: trainer name, trainer ID, your user name in file paths, or the save file itself.
Report_AttachSave: If the problem depends on a save, you can attach it by hand. It contains your game data, so only share it if you are comfortable doing so.
Help_LinkCopied: Couldn't open the browser. The link was copied to the clipboard.
Help_PathCopied: Couldn't open the folder. Its path was copied to the clipboard.
Crash_Subtitle: Max Potion ran into an unexpected error.
Crash_Note: If you were about to save or export, check your save before going on. You can continue or report the error.
Crash_LogHint: The details were also written to the log folder ({0}).
Status_Db_Missing: pokemon.db not found: Pokémon data is missing
Status_Db_AppTooOld: The database is newer than this Max Potion: update the app
Status_Db_DbTooOld: The database is older than this Max Potion: update pokemon.db
